integrity.evidence_basis: analytic derivation plus independently implemented exact small-state checks

scientific_limitations: Simple, non-lazy discrete-time walk on n triangles sharing one common hub, started at that hub.
The distribution expansion is pointwise for fixed real centered x; no uniformity in x or arbitrary petal lengths is established.
The graph-general exact cover-time inclusion-exclusion identity is earlier literature and is not claimed as new.
Definitive historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: A fractional Gumbel correction for simple-walk cover times on friendship graphs
